features.name: any_comment_bullet_list
features.definition: Does at least one counter-argument comment contain bullet-list formatting?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments as a JSON list of strings (json.loads). If missing/malformed, return null. If empty list, return 0. Return 1 if any comment contains at least two lines, each matching regex r'^\s*(\\?[-*+•])\s+\S' (multiline, markdown unordered bullet markers, optionally backslash-escaped), else 0. Numbered lists are not counted. Raw text matching only; no semantic filtering.

h0: any_comment_bullet_list has no association with the probability that the OP changed their view (delta).
h1: Discussions with any_comment_bullet_list = 1 have a higher rate of OP view change than those with 0.
note: Persuasiveness operationalized as dataset outcome delta (OP view change). Bullet list defined as markdown unordered list with at least two bullet lines; the threshold of two is an operational assumption. Numbered lists excluded. Comments are unordered, per-comment outcomes unavailable, so row-level presence is a coarse measure; the bullet comment need not be the persuasive one. Raw text may include outcome announcements or later replies; the feature is mechanical and not outcome-free. Association only, not causal.
